subject: QBR prep: engagement ops flagged accounts + exec attention items
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR prep: engagement ops flagged accounts + exec attention items

Hi team,

We're consolidating our QBR packet for next week's exec review and I wanted to flag a short list of accounts where engagement ops show elevated risk and we should consider explicit exec outreach or a pre-brief. I attached a one-page health summary and a working renewal risk register. Quick summary below — please update the register directly and reply with any blockers by EOD.

Top flagged accounts (high-level):
- Glacier AI — usage decline on inference endpoints (30% drop last 6w), open postmortem for two infra incidents in July, renewal in 45 days. Recommend: schedule customer CTO touchpoint + offer 2-week reliability burst.
- Meridian Health — rising error rates on embeddings route tied to model switch; CS currently triaging. Renewal in 70 days. Recommend: prioritized incident runbook + canary rollback plan.
- Acuris Labs — contract upsell at risk due to cost spike; batching/quantization suggestions outstanding. Renewal in 55 days. Recommend: pricing write-up for finance and potential 3-month credit.

Asks:
1) Lauren — can you validate Glacier's usage and confirm the incident RCA status in the attached risk register?
2) Marissa — please add projected TCO impact per account and a recommended credit/comp package if applicable.
3) Marcus — draft a one-paragraph exec brief for each account we can use to loop in the appropriate sponsor (CEO/CTO/CRO).

Attachments: glacier-qbr-health-summary-20280811.xlsx (health dashboard), glacier-renewal-risk-register-20280811.csv (editable).

Goal: have a finalized exec-ready packet by COB Friday so we can route to the leadership docket on Monday.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: engagement ops flagged accounts + exec attention items

Jordan — thanks for the summary. Quick notes after a first pass on Glacier (I updated the csv):

- Usage: confirmed 30% drop concentrated in two customer-hosted endpoints after a client-side library bump on 07/12. We saw corresponding retry storms that increased tail latency. I left the traffic slices in the register.
- RCA: infra team provided a draft RCA yesterday; root cause is misconfigured backpressure on our gateway under bursty retry patterns. Patch PR is staged for canary this week.
- Customer sentiment: CS has a note that the Glacier eng manager is 'frustrated' but remains open to an architecture review.

Recommend we do the CTO pre-brief before the exec review — if the patch can be staged and we offer a small SLA credit it should materially lower renewal risk.

I'll finish the TCO numbers tonight and drop a short paragraph into the sheet for the exec brief.

On the Meridian item, I've asked product to snapshot the embeddings regression and will add their note to the register.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success Operations
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-11T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: engagement ops flagged accounts + exec attention items

Adding the TCO numbers and my recommended compensation packages — see updated register + a short risk summary per account (I attached the CSV export for quick reference). Highlights: 

- Glacier AI (renewal in 45 days) — projected ARR at risk: $420k. Recommended remediation: 1) CTO pre-brief + architecture review; 2) one-time reliability credit equal to 1% ARR (to be converted to a short-term invoice credit), and 3) offer a prioritized implementation window for the patch with a dedicated SRE.

- Meridian Health — projected ARR at risk: $210k. Recommended: scoped rollback plan and an embed-model-specific SLA.

- Acuris Labs — projected ARR at risk: $180k. Recommended: two options for commercial: (a) provide a temporary usage credit while we apply quantization profile, or (b) deferred billing for the next invoice cycle while we implement batching improvements.

Marcus — I drafted three one-paragraph exec blurbs in the register. Jordan, if you want, I can route the Glacier blurb to Olivia (customer CTO) as a pre-brief note once we have alignment on the credit and patch ETA.

Attachments: glacier-renewal-risk-register-20280811.csv (updated), glacier-qbr-health-summary-20280811.xlsx (same copy).

Thanks — I'll be on standby for any edits.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia@glacierai.com>
Date: 2028-08-12T15:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: engagement ops flagged accounts + exec attention items

Thanks all — quick update and next steps.

- Lauren: appreciate the RCA confirmation. Once the canary is scoped (ETA 8/14) please share a short status note we can include in the exec packet.
- Marissa: thanks for the TCO and recommended packages; I authorized start of the credit approval thread with finance (keeps the ask small while we prove stability).
- Marcus: please finalize the three exec blurbs by tomorrow morning; we'll attach them to the leadership docket.

Olivia — wanted to loop you in so you're aware we're preparing a short CTO-level pre-brief tomorrow to share our mitigation plan and proposed credit. Would you be available for a 30-minute call on 8/13 or 8/14? We're aiming to be proactive ahead of the QBR.

I'll collect the final packet and route to the exec docket for Monday. Appreciate quick turn on this.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
